headline: Bonsai 2 27B whitepaper reports roughly three-quarter retention on two agentic coding benchmarks
summary: PrismML’s September 17, 2026 whitepaper reports Ternary Bonsai 2 27B at 52.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 60.8% resolved on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 69.7 and 80.6 for Qwen3.8-27B FP16. The paper says the Terminal-Bench run used Terminus-2 on 89 tasks with one attempt each, while SWE-bench Verified used mini-swe-agent on all 500 instances. These two agentic results are separate from the paper’s 20-benchmark aggregate, where Bonsai 2 scores 83.9 versus 85.4 (98.2% retention). This is a bounded vendor-reported quality tradeoff, not independent validation; checkpoint hashes, run traces and independent reproduction remain open.
